submitPage.title: Submit your site
submitPage.body: If you've built a nostalgic playlist site - barbershop, road-trip, wedding, festival, or everyday - let us know. Open a pull request with a new entry, or message us on X.
steps: Fill in your entry's details in data/entries.json

aboutPage.title: One idea, many stories
aboutPage.body1: In the early 2020s, @ybhrdwj built saloon.wtf - a playlist site for the 90s Bollywood songs that play at Indian barbershops. The idea went viral, and people started building dozens of their own - for road trips, weddings, festivals, everyday routines.
aboutPage.body2: Goonj is an attempt to bring all of those sites together in one place - a directory, so none of them get lost.
